name: 系统健身培训课程款
description: 教练指导、系统课程体系、真实训练氛围与阶段性成果展示的课程服务套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal gradient #1C1F26 for hero, pain and CTA bands; light lavender-grey #F2F1F4 for infographic, comparison and trust sections
styleLock.lightingSystem: directional studio and natural window light, cool-neutral 5000-5500K in scene shots, rim light on athletes, deep controlled shadows, clean high-key light on infographic sections
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte rubber gym flooring, brushed steel equipment, matte light-grey walls
styleLock.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines 28-48pt, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and solid rounded label chips in the single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: athletes appear only as generic role figures shown from behind or cropped, faces never visible; stable scale and placement across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent energetic premium fitness-training visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #1C1F26, light lavender-grey #F2F1F4, pure white text #FFFFFF, one orange-red accent #E8442E and one cool blue secondary accent #2E8FE8; directional studio and natural window lighting, cool-neutral 5000-5500K in scene shots, rim light on athletes, deep controlled shadows, clean high-key light on infographic sections; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent thin-line icons and solid rounded label chips in a single accent color; real gym environment with matte rubber flooring and brushed steel equipment; athletes shown only as generic role figures from behind or cropped, faces never visible; fully composed frames with balanced margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no visible faces.

shots.intent: 开场用动感训练场景建立专业氛围，一秒传达课程主卖点
shots.camera: low side angle looking slightly upward, full training scene
shots.lighting: cool rim light on the athlete, soft warm glow from the upper right, deep controlled shadows
shots.background: deep charcoal gradient #1C1F26 with subtle glow
shots.props: standard gym equipment in the scene, not covering the subject
shots.textZone: lower-third typography block: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one short subtitle 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce hero cover of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A dynamic gym training scene photographed from a low side angle looking slightly upward: a generic athlete, shown from behind with the face not visible, is mid-exercise on training equipment, filling 50-60% of the frame in the upper two-thirds. Deep charcoal gradient background #1C1F26 with a soft warm glow from the upper right, cool rim light on the athlete, deep controlled shadows. The lower third carries the typography block: a short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF sized 28-48pt with one short subtitle 「{callout_1}」 beneath it, set clear of the athlete silhouette. Negative: no visible faces, no brand logos, no watermark, no garbled text, no dense body copy, no QR code, no cut-off limbs, no cluttered background.

shots.intent: 主图一秒法则，用大字报直给课程最核心的训练利益
shots.camera: slight front 3/4 eye-level mid shot, subject on the right
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, soft contact shadow
shots.textZone: left 40% typography block: one short headline 「{selling_point_2}」 in #2D2D2D with one thin-line icon in #E8442E
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Mid shot at a slight front 3/4 eye-level angle: a generic athlete, back turned with the face not visible, performing a controlled training movement on the right side, filling 50-60% of the frame. Light lavender-grey background #F2F1F4, soft front-left key light, soft contact shadow. The left 40% carries the composed typography block: one short headline 「{selling_point_2}」 in #2D2D2D sized 28-48pt and one thin-line icon in #E8442E above it, so the type and the athlete balance the tall canvas. Negative: no visible faces, no more than one claim, no invented efficacy or results, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 放大盲目训练、方法错误的挫败感，为系统课程制造需求
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, documentary eye-level on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel dim and harsh, right panel bright and clean
shots.background: deep charcoal #1C1F26 on the left panel, light lavender-grey #F2F1F4 on the right panel
shots.props: scattered training gear embodying the pain, not covering the subject
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two matched panels with identical documentary eye-level framing. Left panel: an unsupervised self-training scene with visibly wrong exercise form under dim harsh light, conveying confusion and wasted effort, candid feel, no face visible. Right panel: the same exercise performed with correct guided form under bright clean light. Background deep charcoal #1C1F26 on the left panel and light lavender-grey #F2F1F4 on the right panel. One short label per panel, 「{callout_1}」 on the left and 「{callout_2}」 on the right, each placed in the upper corner of its panel. The subject fills 50-60% of each panel so both halves read dense and matched. Negative: no visible faces, no fabricated injuries or statistics, no garbled text, no watermark, no fake logo, no deformed limbs.

shots.intent: 真实场馆氛围让学员代入上课场景，建立专业与陪伴感
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down over the gym floor, wide environment shot
shots.lighting: natural window light from the left, 5500K, realistic soft shadows
shots.background: real gym floor with matte rubber flooring and brushed steel equipment
shots.props: standard gym equipment in the background, not covering the subjects
shots.whitespace: natural breathing room from the open gym floor around the coaching pair
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Wide gym-floor environment photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down: a generic coach figure, face not visible, guiding a trainee through an exercise, the environment is the co-star. Natural window light from the left, 5500K, realistic soft shadows on matte rubber gym flooring. Props limited to standard gym equipment in the background, not covering the subjects. Subjects and equipment fill 40-50% of the frame, with the open gym floor giving natural breathing room around the coaching pair, and a short caption 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF sits in the lower third of the scene. Negative: no visible faces, no hands covering the subject, no duplicated background textures, no garbled wall signage, no extra text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用抓握、镁粉、器械细节特写证明训练的专业强度
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro at a low 30-degree angle close to the bar, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing texture, controlled highlight
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the subject
shots.textZone: small annotation label 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF at the lower corner
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product} in action: tight zoom on chalked hands gripping a barbell, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Macro close-up at a low 30-degree angle close to the bar. Raking side light from the right revealing skin texture, chalk dust and knurling detail. Dark charcoal background #1C1F26 blurred out. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with margins kept minimal because the grip itself is the subject, and a small annotation label 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF sits at the lower corner. Negative: no visible face, no deformed fingers or fused hands, no blurry subject, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 信息图讲清课程体系的模块构成，消除不知道学什么的疑虑
shots.lighting: even flat high-key lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: six rounded info cards with thin-line icons
shots.whitespace: about 15% layout margins around the card grid
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_3}」 in #2D2D2D at the top, six rounded cards each with a short label 「{callout_1}」 to 「{callout_6}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic layout for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Structured course-system grid presented as a clean flat design photographed from a straight-on top-down 90-degree angle: a headline 「{selling_point_3}」 in #2D2D2D sized 28-48pt at the top, and below it a two-column grid of six rounded cards, each card holding a thin-line cube icon in #E8442E and a short label 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」, 「{callout_4}」, 「{callout_5}」, 「{callout_6}」. Light lavender-grey background #F2F1F4, even flat high-key lighting, no dramatic shadow. The headline and card grid together occupy 55-60% of the frame, centered with about 15% layout margins on each side. Negative: no tiny unreadable text, no dense body paragraphs, no invented course counts or credentials, no photos inside the cards, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 同机位左右对比无计划盲练与系统课程安排，证明方法价值
shots.camera: two matched panels, identical straight-on framing, camera and lighting on both sides
shots.lighting: identical on both panels, clean even light with a slightly dimmer left side
shots.props: left: scattered equipment and notes; right: structured plan cards
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two matched panels with identical straight-on framing, camera and lighting on both sides. Left panel: aimless random workouts, scattered equipment and messy notes rendered disorganized under slightly dimmer light, labeled 「{callout_1}」. Right panel: the same training space organized into a clear progressive plan with structured weekly plan cards, bright and orderly, labeled 「{callout_2}」. Light lavender-grey #F2F1F4 background on both panels. Each panel carries one short label at its top edge, and the scene content fills a balanced 50-60% of each panel so the two halves read as a matched pair. Negative: no visible faces, no fabricated before-and-after body results, no fabricated data, no garbled text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用服务保障条目与安心训练氛围降低报名决策风险
shots.camera: slight front 3/4 eye-level composition, subject left, chips right
shots.props: four solid rounded chips in orange-red #E8442E
shots.textZone: four short trust labels 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」, 「{callout_4}」 in #2D2D2D beside the solid chips
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A slight front 3/4 eye-level composition: on the left a calm gym scene with a generic athlete stretching, back turned and face not visible, filling 50-60% of the frame; on the right a vertical stack of four solid rounded chips filled orange-red #E8442E, each chip followed by one short trust label 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」, 「{callout_4}」 in #2D2D2D at 10-14pt. Light lavender-grey background #F2F1F4, even clean studio light. The scene and the chip stack together complete the tall canvas with even spacing between the four rows. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, test data or statistics; no fabricated badges, no fake logos, no watermark, no visible faces, no dense text.

shots.intent: 收口促行动，用品牌色氛围与实色行动按钮承接转化
shots.camera: slight low-angle hero composition, subject centered
shots.lighting: punchy directional rim light, subtle orange-red accent glow from behind, deep controlled shadows
shots.background: deep charcoal gradient #1C1F26 with accent glow #E8442E
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_4}」 in #FFFFFF at the upper third, one solid rounded action button filled #E8442E with the action text 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF below it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A slight low-angle hero composition: a generic athlete finishing a workout with arms raised, shown from behind with the face not visible, centered and filling 50-60% of the frame, on a deep charcoal gradient background #1C1F26 with a subtle accent glow #E8442E from behind. Punchy directional rim light, deep controlled shadows. The upper third carries the headline 「{selling_point_4}」 in #FFFFFF sized 28-48pt, and below it one solid rounded action button filled #E8442E with the action text 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF, no outline-only or transparent buttons. Negative: no invented discounts, prices or countdowns, no QR code, no visible faces, no garbled text, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 从 9 张健身培训课程爆款详情长图切片提炼；源图为服务类商品（健身课程），按服务类转化语法设计。已剥离：源机构品牌字与 logo、同一模特的三次重复形象（panels 03/04/05/07 合并为通用角色镜头）、近似重复的场馆照片（panels 01/08/09 合并为场景镜头）、原文案、会员促销贴片与二维码（panel-09）。人物一律通用角色不露脸，课程/服务一律以 {product} 占位，数据与资质一律不虚构，信任镜以可验证的场景细节与模板文案槽位表达。
